selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the globe invite the traveler to do first?
questions.answer: It invites him to look at its works and learn from what it shows.

questions.question: What does the globe want the traveler to read?
questions.answer: It wants him to read its pages, meaning its signs and functions.

questions.question: What results from the earth’s motion around its path?
questions.answer: The passing of time in regular patterns such as days, years, and seasons.

questions.question: Where is this great ship said to be traveling?
questions.answer: It is traveling through space while circling the sun.

questions.question: What does each page of the earth announce?
questions.answer: Each page announces the One who sustains and governs it.

questions.question: Which topic on the earth’s page does the traveler study?
questions.answer: He studies the coming into being and spreading of living things in spring.

questions.question: How are these seeds and young living things treated after they appear?
questions.answer: They are distributed, fed, and raised with great care.

questions.question: What does this spreading tell us about nature in the passage?
questions.answer: It tells us that life is arranged with purpose and wisdom.

questions.question: Why is nourishment for babies given special attention?
questions.answer: Because it strongly shows gentleness, compassion, and wise planning.

questions.question: How does spring support belief in life after death?
questions.answer: The return of life across the earth each year is presented as a clear example that reviving the dead is possible.

questions.question: Why does the globe speak to the traveler in the passage?
questions.answer: It wants to show him what he has been searching for.

questions.question: What does “read my pages” mean in this passage?
questions.answer: It means to study the signs, works, and patterns found in the earth.

questions.question: What does floating in space with balance suggest about the earth?
questions.answer: It suggests that it is kept in a stable and measured condition.

questions.question: How does the traveler describe the earth after looking at it closely?
questions.answer: He sees it like a book full of signs pointing to its Sustainer.

questions.question: What does the traveler discover when he examines the earth like a text?
questions.answer: He discovers many signs pointing to the Sustainer of the earth.

questions.question: What three kinds of care are mentioned for living things after they appear?
questions.answer: They are spread out well, provided for, and raised carefully.

questions.question: Why is it important that many foods come from sources that look very similar?
questions.answer: It shows that very different and useful results can come from simple and similar beginnings.

questions.question: How are living things supported after they appear?
questions.answer: They are provided for and raised with mercy and care.

questions.question: What lesson does the revival of the earth after death-like stillness teach?
questions.answer: It teaches that the One who restores life to the earth can also raise the dead.

questions.question: What does the traveler understand about the verse mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: He understands that its meaning is clearly shown in the events of spring.

questions.question: What change in direction happens at the start of the target passage?
questions.answer: Attention shifts from searching the heavens to learning from the earth.

questions.question: What happens to some seeds in a remarkable way?
questions.answer: Some are given means to travel through the air so they can spread to other places.

questions.question: What special gift is given to some seeds?
questions.answer: They are given the ability to travel and spread.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does reviving the earth after winter point to?
questions.answer: It points to the power to raise the dead back to life.
